liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Ollin Arrageed** (2 reviews): The Ollin Arrageed into Fire On The Mountain transition is superb; Drums patterned with sustained bass sound in this version of Ollin Arrageed [22][26]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-09-16.sbd.miller.88314.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 221 min; rated 4.33/5 by 3 [1]
- **gd1978-09-16.143122.mtx.ktobin.flac1644**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 213 min [2]
- **gd1978-09-16.mtx.tobin.95316.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 206 min [5]
- **gd1978-09-16.mtx.dts.tobin.95327.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 206 min [6]
- **gd78-09-16.sbd.orf.2319.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 201 min; rated 4.14/5 by 29 [11]. Said about its sound: Recording sounds great with real emotion and a set mood in Egypt; One of the cleanest sounding shows downloaded from the site; Crisp sound but levels off, with guitar heavy and others lost [19][23][24][25][28]

## Around the show

- Playing at the foot of a pyramid adds novelty to the show [25]
- Audience dancing in front of the Sphinx on a fine September evening [29]
- Best of the Egypt shows, tighter than previous nights but below par for 1978 [20]
- First two nights considered garbage, but this show finishes strong [27]
- Lacks drive, contrasting with the 11-20-78 show or versions with Brent [28]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-09-16.sbd.miller.88314.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> PCM -> Dat (48k) D [1]. Also: Lineage: Unknown mics to cassette master, then cassette, patched by chopper7 [1]
- **gd1978-09-16.143122.mtx.ktobin.flac1644**: transferred by Matrix by Kevin Tobin; source: SBD + AUD Matrix 3 Source Mix (44/16) [2]. Also: Mixed by archive.org user, converted to FLAC on 15-SEP-2018 [2]
- **gd1978-09-16.mtx.tobin.95316.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [5]. Also: SBD master reel to PCM, then Dat, transferred by Charlie Miller; Audience: Nakamichi 700 mics to Sony TCM 158 recorder, then cassette [5]
- **gd1978-09-16.mtx.dts.tobin.95327.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [6]. Also: SBD master reel to PCM, then Dat, transferred by Charlie Miller; Audience: Nakamichi 700 mics to Sony TCM 158 recorder, then cassette [6]
- **gd78-09-16.sbd.orf.2319.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Adrian Boot: [1978-09-16 Giza Sound and Light Theater, Cairo, Egypt - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-09-16-giza-sound-and-light-theater-cairo-egypt/) [31]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [The Grateful Dead From Egypt With Love Gizah Egypt 1978 | #38951657](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/the-grateful-dead-from-egypt-with-love-gizah-egypt) [32]
- Poster by Adrian Boot: [1978-09-14 Giza Sound and Light Theater, Cairo, Egypt - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1978-09-14-giza-sound-and-light-theater-cairo-egypt/) [33]
